comment: The shared conformance matrix. Both the Ruby and TypeScript anchoring implementations are driven over these cases and must report identical resolution states. This file is the deliverable the PRD calls the mechanism that keeps client and server in agreement; it is read by test/lib/shortbread/anchoring_conformance_test.rb and test/frontend/anchoring.test.ts.

extraction.name: collapses whitespace the way a browser renders it
